claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.grant_inspiration_die
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ClassFeatureEffect union only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. Bardic Inspiration grants a Bardic Inspiration die (a reusable die resource) to another creature. The recipient holds it and may spend it post-roll after failing a D20 Test to add the die's value to the d20, potentially turning failure into success. No current variant can represent this without misrepresenting the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature gains one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. Once within the next hour when the creature fails a D20 Test, the creature can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. A Bardic Inspiration die is expended when it's rolled.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current UseCountCap has fixed (literal number) and threshold_tiers (level-tiered number) variants. Bardic Inspiration's use count is the caster's Charisma modifier (minimum 1) — an ability-score-derived cap with no level axis. A new variant is required to represent this without hardcoding an incorrect fixed number.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can confer a Bardic Inspiration die a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
